summary: Legend Biotech filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held September 24, 2026. Holders of roughly 330,199,682 ordinary shares, about 84.9% of the 388,976,826 outstanding as of the August 17, 2026 record date, voted. Shareholders received audited FY2025 financials, ratified Ernst & Young as FY2026 auditor, re-elected Class III directors Robin Meng, Corazon D. Sanders, Li Mao and Peter Salovey, and approved adding 19,100,000 ordinary shares to the 2020 Restricted Shares Plan. No special-situation transaction, no board recommendation, advisors, deal terms or structural mechanics beyond routine governance items. Watch only routine dilution from the equity-plan increase.
